blocks.path: How to lower your cholesterol - High cholesterol > Ways to lower your cholesterol > Eat less fatty food
s: To reduce your cholesterol, try to cut down on fatty food, especially food that contains a type of fat called saturated fat.

blocks.path: How to lower your cholesterol - High cholesterol > Ways to lower your cholesterol > Eat less fatty food
s: You can still have foods that contain a healthier type of fat called unsaturated fat.

blocks.path: How to lower your cholesterol - High cholesterol > Ways to lower your cholesterol > Eat less fatty food
s: Check labels on food to see what type of fat it has in it.

blocks.path: How to lower your cholesterol - High cholesterol > Ways to lower your cholesterol > Eat less fatty food > Try to eat more:
s: oily fish, like mackerel and salmon

blocks.path: How to lower your cholesterol - High cholesterol > Ways to lower your cholesterol > Eat less fatty food > Try to eat more:
s: olive oil, rapeseed oil and spreads made from these oils

blocks.path: How to lower your cholesterol - High cholesterol > Ways to lower your cholesterol > Eat less fatty food > Try to eat more:
s: brown rice, wholegrain bread and wholewheat pasta

blocks.path: How to lower your cholesterol - High cholesterol > Ways to lower your cholesterol > Eat less fatty food > Try to eat more:
s: nuts and seeds

blocks.path: How to lower your cholesterol - High cholesterol > Ways to lower your cholesterol > Eat less fatty food > Try to eat more:
s: fruits and vegetables

blocks.path: How to lower your cholesterol - High cholesterol > Ways to lower your cholesterol > Eat less fatty food > Try to eat less:
s: meat pies, sausages and fatty meat

blocks.path: How to lower your cholesterol - High cholesterol > Ways to lower your cholesterol > Eat less fatty food > Try to eat less:
s: butter, lard and ghee

blocks.path: How to lower your cholesterol - High cholesterol > Ways to lower your cholesterol > Eat less fatty food > Try to eat less:
s: cream and cheese

blocks.path: How to lower your cholesterol - High cholesterol > Ways to lower your cholesterol > Eat less fatty food > Try to eat less:
s: cakes and biscuits

blocks.path: How to lower your cholesterol - High cholesterol > Ways to lower your cholesterol > Eat less fatty food > Try to eat less:
s: food that contains coconut oil or palm oil

blocks.path: How to lower your cholesterol - High cholesterol > Ways to lower your cholesterol > Exercise more
s: Aim to do at least 150 minutes (2.5 hours) of moderate intensity exercise or 75 minutes of vigorous intensity activity a week.

blocks.path: How to lower your cholesterol - High cholesterol > Ways to lower your cholesterol > Exercise more
s: Some good things to try when starting out include:

blocks.path: How to lower your cholesterol - High cholesterol > Ways to lower your cholesterol > Exercise more
s: walking – try to walk fast enough so your heart starts beating faster

blocks.path: How to lower your cholesterol - High cholesterol > Ways to lower your cholesterol > Exercise more
s: swimming

blocks.path: How to lower your cholesterol - High cholesterol > Ways to lower your cholesterol > Exercise more
s: cycling

blocks.path: How to lower your cholesterol - High cholesterol > Ways to lower your cholesterol > Exercise more
s: Try a few different exercises to find something you like doing.
You're more likely to keep doing it if you enjoy it.

blocks.path: How to lower your cholesterol - High cholesterol > Ways to lower your cholesterol > Stop smoking
s: Smoking can raise your cholesterol and make you more likely to have serious problems like heart attacks, strokes and cancer.

blocks.path: How to lower your cholesterol - High cholesterol > Ways to lower your cholesterol > Stop smoking
s: If you want to stop smoking, you can get help and support from:

blocks.path: How to lower your cholesterol - High cholesterol > Ways to lower your cholesterol > Stop smoking
s: your GP

blocks.path: How to lower your cholesterol - High cholesterol > Ways to lower your cholesterol > Stop smoking
s: NHS stop smoking services

blocks.path: How to lower your cholesterol - High cholesterol > Ways to lower your cholesterol > Stop smoking
s: They can give you useful tips and advice about ways to stop cravings.

blocks.path: How to lower your cholesterol - High cholesterol > Ways to lower your cholesterol > Cut down on alcohol
s: Try to:

blocks.path: How to lower your cholesterol - High cholesterol > Ways to lower your cholesterol > Cut down on alcohol
s: avoid drinking more than 14 units of alcohol a week on a regular basis

blocks.path: How to lower your cholesterol - High cholesterol > Ways to lower your cholesterol > Cut down on alcohol
s: spread your drinking over 3 or more days if you regularly drink as much as 14 units a week

blocks.path: How to lower your cholesterol - High cholesterol > Ways to lower your cholesterol > Cut down on alcohol
s: have several drink-free days each week

blocks.path: How to lower your cholesterol - High cholesterol > Ways to lower your cholesterol > Cut down on alcohol
s: Ask your GP for help and advice if you're struggling to cut down.
